method: Visual inspection of original native test captures; no pixel transformation or screenshot comparison assertions.

captures.observation: Native inline editor title, grouped Form and address/link inputs readable at represented size; source baseline predates final inspector/List-sidebar fixes.
Search remains garden after destination return; crowded toolbar omitted plan title in this earlier capture; current source adds a content heading.
Native sidebar replaces floating tab tier; portrait sidebar overlays empty middle-pane guidance, using standard split-view adaptation.
Dark native editor grouped surfaces, controls, text, address fields and Add Link remain visible; no forced light surface.
Dark selected Item detail and catalog are readable with native toolbar/search and completion switch.
Screen capture shows complete landscape sidebar/catalog/detail panes. Earlier application screenshot crop problem is absent.
Native mobile month uses dark appearance, clear selected day and empty agenda; sidebar does not add a floating tab tier.
Dark Calendar Week keeps selected Item inspector after narrowing. Grid scrolls horizontally beside readable details.
Rich dark draft retains notes, duration, address and link after rotation. List name is absent from crowded toolbar; adding a content heading is the remaining local correction.

Dark phone editor uses native grouped Form, readable entered notes and system bottom tabs. Location continues beneath the floating bar and is reachable by scrolling; the rich draft journey passes its field/relaunch checks. Full large-text/scroll visual acceptance remains separate.
Dark phone selected details show readable notes, completion and estimate, with native bottom tabs and pushed-page Back navigation.

Dark landscape phone retains native bottom tabs centered within its content width, readable selected details and working completion. The native bar overlays scrolling content; this is not final large-text/scroll acceptance.
Dark phone Itinerary shows retained garden search, readable route heading and native bottom tabs after destination return.
Light phone editor follows system grouped Form, readable entered text and native bottom tabs; lower address content requires scrolling past the floating bar.
Light phone selected detail has readable notes and native completion control; matching dark capture retains the same hierarchy.

Light phone month uses native date selection and segmented modes. Initial empty-agenda description extends behind the floating bottom bar within the scroll view; complete scroll/large-text review remains open.
Final light tablet capture shows Origin List heading above estimates while rich draft notes, duration, address and link remain visible after rotation; crowded toolbar no longer hides List context.
Final light tablet Itinerary retains garden search and readable Afternoon route heading after destination switch.

limits: Representative navigation/editor/Calendar captures only. Full scene/state, accessibility, physical-device and final polish review remain open.
